entries.title: West Bridgford Library — Rattle, Rhyme and Roll
entries.description: (Friday 10:00–10:30 and 11:00–11:30; free; adults need free tickets from 09:45). Singing/socialising.

entries.title: St Giles Church — Story & Singing
entries.description: (Friday term-time, free drop-in; exact time requires confirmation). Songs, stories, crafts/toys.

entries.title: Little Rockets, Edwalton
entries.description: (The Rock Hub, 13–15 Wellin Lane; Friday term-time 10:00–11:30; £2.50/family). Toys, craft/messy play, soft play, songs.

entries.title: Bridgford Park play area
entries.description: (Central Avenue). Sand factory, swings, climbing, local option.

entries.title: Boundary Road play area
entries.description: (NG2 7DB). Modern rope/climbing/zip line, features for young children.

entries.title: Greythorn Drive play area
entries.description: (NG2 7GD). New jeep, swings, play panels and climbing; very convenient for a short local outing.

entries.title: Alford Road pirate playground
entries.description: (Edwalton NG2 6HP). Pirate 'walk the plank' and climbing.

entries.title: West Park junior play area
entries.description: (Loughborough Road NG2 7JE). Local park/play.

entries.title: The Hook junior play area and reserve
entries.description: (Holme Road NG2 5BG). Play then natural area/river proximity.

entries.title: Bridge Field playground
entries.description: (Bridgford Road NG2 6AN). Useful short stop.

entries.title: Adbolton Lane playground
entries.description: (Lady Bay NG2 5AX). Modern equipment incl music/tactile features.

entries.title: Oak Tree Close playground
entries.description: (Lady Bay NG2 5DE). Compact local play.

entries.title: Victoria Embankment and Memorial Gardens
entries.description: (NG2 2AA). River, paths and playground; can spot boats and bridges. Source/park search: Nottingham City Council.

entries.title: Wilford Village Green / riverside
entries.description: (NG11 7AH). Short local ramble; use direct verified route.

entries.title: Skylarks Nature Reserve
entries.description: (Adbolton Lane NG12 2LU). Pond/wildlife and paths; outdoor. Source: Nottinghamshire Wildlife Trust.

entries.title: Holme Pierrepont Country Park / watersports centre
entries.description: (NG12 2LU). Watch watersports on operating days, walk lake; check activities/open access.

entries.title: The Hook Nature Reserve
entries.description: (Holme Grove area): nature/water routes separate from playground. Council/local listing; check path conditions.

entries.title: West Bridgford Methodist Toddler Time
entries.description: (Musters Road): TUESDAY, not Friday, during term, 09:30–11:30. Keep for other dates.
entries.caution: Not operating on Friday 9 October; check actual dates

entries.title: Rushcliffe Arena
entries.description: (Rugby Road): swimming with published public schedule subject to pool availability. Check leisure provider.

entries.title: Lady Bay local church/community events
entries.description: explore for actual dated children's/community events; don't claim public preschool is drop-in.

entries.title: Rushcliffe Country Park
entries.description: (Ruddington). Giant renovated climbing/play area, lake circuit, ducks and railway heritage alongside; park free, parking £1.50 up to 3h, car park 08:00–18:00.

entries.title: Framework Knitters Museum
entries.description: (Ruddington). Historic knitting machinery and possible demonstrations; listed Friday 11am–4pm; confirm opening and demonstrations.

entries.title: Nottingham Transport Heritage Centre
entries.description: (Ruddington): rolling stock and heritage rail. Weekend hours in structured listing; not generally open Friday — only include for Friday if special event published.
entries.caution: Not operating on Friday 9 October; check actual dates

entries.title: Bingham Library — Rattle, Rhyme and Roll
entries.description: Friday 10:00–10:30 term time, free. ONLY worth visiting as a group if already in Bingham or there's another interesting reason; similar much closer to home.

entries.title: Cotgrave Library — Places of Welcome
entries.description: Fridays 10:30–12; not a toddler class but sociable stop. Friday rhyme time NOT published.

entries.title: Attenborough Nature Centre and reserve
entries.description: (Barton Lane NG9 6DY). Wetlands, wildlife, cafe, accessible paths; free entry with paid parking.

entries.title: Attenborough Adventurers Stay and Play
entries.description: under-5s woodland session, Friday 09:30–11:30 on multiple 2026 autumn dates. Must verify requested date and book.

entries.title: Highfields Park boating lake and playground
entries.description: (University Boulevard NG7). Boats seasonal, playground, paths; venue open Friday. Verify boat activity separately.

entries.title: Lakeside Arts / Djanogly Gallery
entries.description: (University Park NG7 2RD). Exhibitions and family programmes; 2026 Trent Valley prehistoric exhibition Thu–Sun noon–16h.

entries.title: Little Foxes Play Town
entries.description: (100 Chilwell Rd, Beeston NG9 1ES): 90-min role-play, listed Friday 09:30–15h, check bookable slots.

entries.title: Hocus Pocus Soft Play
entries.description: (131 Queens Road East, Beeston NG9 2FE). Indoor play; listings show Friday 09:30–18h; confirm toddler suitability/prices.

entries.title: Bramcote Leisure Centre splash pool
entries.description: public parent/toddler swim times must be checked; under-4s free with leisure pass.

entries.title: Colwick Country Park
entries.description: (Racecourse Road NG2 4BH). Lakes and wildlife, good carrier/wellies walk.

entries.title: Stonebridge City Farm
entries.description: (Stonebridge Road NG3 2FR). Free/donation animals and playground, published Fri 10–16:15.

entries.title: Green's Windmill Science Centre & garden
entries.description: (Windmill Lane NG2 4QB): free, Wed–Sun 10–16h. Windmill tower CLOSED for repairs since Nov 2025; science centre/garden open.
entries.caution: Windmill building closed for repairs; science centre and garden open

entries.title: Nottingham Contemporary
entries.description: (Weekday Cross NG1). Free art exhibitions, family activities on selected dates; Fri 10–17h.

entries.title: Wollaton Hall & Deer Park
entries.description: (NG8 2AE). Deer spotting, grounds, natural history museum (Fri ~11–16h).

entries.title: Nottingham Castle & grounds
entries.description: Historic Nottingham attraction; check opening times, admission and access for toddlers.

entries.title: National Ice Centre
entries.description: (NG1): public skating; age 5 & under go free with paying adult, but dedicated Tots Zone is Saturday AM/Sunday PM, not Friday; weekday Parent and Tots schedule requires booking check.

entries.title: Fun Valley
entries.description: (Netherfield NG4 2BA). Indoor play; listed Fri 10–18h; verify actual session/prices.

entries.title: Pirates Play, Party & Laser Centre
entries.description: (Rowley Drive NG5). Soft play portion, listed Fri 09:30–18h. Exclude laser activity for toddlers.

entries.title: Meadows Play Centre
entries.description: (Burge Close NG2 2JD). Indoor soft play, Friday listed 10–18h; small independent option, confirm admission.

entries.title: Floralands Farm Park
entries.description: (Catfoot Lane, Lambley NG4). Animals, farm setting; published Fri 10–16h; confirm animal encounter availability.

entries.title: Manor Farm Park & Woodlands
entries.description: (East Leake). Farm/woodland, published Fri 10–17h, confirm admission and special activities.

entries.title: National Space Centre, Leicester
entries.description: Science and space exhibition destination; normally open Friday 10am–4pm. Check session availability and prices.

entries.title: National Justice Museum/City of Caves
entries.description: adult-interest historic venues, but limited suitability for ~2 and hazards; low priority, check age/stairs before offering.

entries.title: White Post Farm & Zoo
entries.description: (Farnsfield NG22 8HL): animals, indoor play, Fri published 10–17h. General day entry accepts under-twos FREE; adult paid.

entries.title: White Post Farm Little Farmers Club
entries.description: Term-time weekday club 10am–noon, £11.95 for child and adult; official advertised minimum age 2 and maximum 4; confirm age eligibility directly. General farm entry not included.
entries.caution: Official minimum age is 2; check before booking

entries.title: Robin Hood's Wheelgate Park
entries.description: (Farnsfield NG22 8HX). Outdoor/indoor rides/play; Friday listed 10:30–17h, check age/height limits.

entries.title: Rufford Abbey Country Park
entries.description: (Ollerton NG22 9DF): play area, lakes, abbey ruins, free entry but parking charge.

entries.title: Newstead Abbey gardens/grounds
entries.description: gardens and historic atmosphere, park daily 10–17h, weekday car £6 published; house normally weekend only.

entries.title: Clumber Park
entries.description: (National Trust, Worksop): expansive trails, play, cycle possibilities. Published daily 08–17h, admission/parking costs apply.

entries.title: The Workhouse and Infirmary, Southwell
entries.description: Victorian building and gardens; special 'Cheer Up Chuckaboo' trail listed 9–16 Oct 2026 10:30–16h, likely more suitable for adults/older kids but interesting.

entries.title: Sundown Adventureland
entries.description: (Retford DN22 0HX): purpose-built young-children theme park, Friday listed 10–16:30h.

entries.title: Twycross Zoo
entries.description: (Atherstone CV9 3PX): animals, talks and indoor facilities; Friday published 10–16h.

entries.title: CONKERS
entries.description: (Moira DE12 6GA): indoor discovery/play and outdoor trails, Friday published 10–17h.

entries.title: Peak Wildlife Park
entries.description: (Winkhill, Leek ST13 7QR): animal enclosures and wildlife park, longer special drive, Fri 10–17h.

entries.title: Great Central Railway (Loughborough)
entries.description: excellent journey-as-activity when TRAIN RUNNING; its public calendar on Friday 9 Oct showed no listed train services, Sat/Sun 10–11 Oct advertised Autumn Steam Weekend.
entries.caution: Not operating on Friday 9 October; check actual dates

entries.title: East Midlands Aeropark
entries.description: (Castle Donington): old aeroplanes and airport viewing, structured hours shown Saturday and Sunday, not Friday, so DO NOT present as open Fridays without a specific event. Check official source.
entries.caution: Not operating on Friday 9 October; check actual dates

entries.title: Nottinghamshire pick-your-own pumpkins, Oxton
entries.description: seasonal; operator/Visit Nottinghamshire says OPEN Sat 10/Sun 11 Oct then 17–31 Oct 2026; NOT Fri 9.
entries.caution: Not operating on Friday 9 October; check actual dates

entries.title: Maxeys Farm Shop Pick up a Pumpkin, Kirklington
entries.description: seasonal; NOT Fri 9 Oct on published 2026 schedule; open Sat/Sun 10/11.
entries.caution: Not operating on Friday 9 October; check actual dates

entries.title: Leicester Abbey Pumping Station
entries.description: giant beam engines/vehicles/narrow gauge railway only open select Mondays and event days; NOT regular Friday outing.
entries.caution: Not operating on Friday 9 October; check actual dates

entries.title: Warwickshire Toddler Trundles
entries.description: (Ryton Pools/Kingsbury, NOT Nottingham): Friday 10am term-time ranger nature sessions, alternating sites, special drive only if novel enough.

entries.title: NCT bus from West Bridgford into Nottingham
entries.description: an activity in itself, maybe stay on for interesting vehicles/city centre; under-5s free on NCT.

entries.title: Tram outing from city/park-and-ride
entries.description: choose an interesting route, windows and stations are part of outing; verify timetable/fares.

entries.title: Regular train short trip to Beeston, Attenborough, Derby, Newark, Leicester
entries.description: train ride itself plus brief exploration at destination, check train service and return route.

entries.title: Station viewing at Nottingham / railway bridge in public areas
entries.description: see different trains without making a paid long visit; choose safe public viewing locations.

entries.title: East Midlands Airport plane spotting from public permitted viewing areas
entries.description: aircraft movements are interesting, distinct from the CLOSED-on-Friday Aeropark museum; verify legal public access/parking before suggesting a specific spot.

entries.title: The Meadows Library, Fun Fridays Totstime
entries.description: Wilford Grove NG2 2DR; every Friday 11:00–11:30, free walk-in songs, rhymes, puppets.

entries.title: Radford-Lenton Library Totstime
entries.description: Fridays 10:30–11:00, free walk-in; farther than Meadows/Bridgford and not worth a standalone long journey.

entries.title: Sherwood Library Totstime
entries.description: Fridays 10:30–11:00, free walk-in; similar.

entries.title: Hucknall Library Little Creatives
entries.description: Special booked workshop Friday 9 October 2026 at 10am, 45 minutes of art and messy play. Advertised for ages 2–5; check age suitability.
entries.caution: Official minimum age is 2; check before booking

entries.title: East Midlands Airport Trail
entries.description: public countryside trail with views over East Midlands Airport, not dependent on Aeropark opening. Check trail entry and safe viewing spots.

entries.title: Crich Tramway Village
entries.description: excellent special transport ride when open, but CLOSED Friday 9 October 2026; autumn Friday opening variable.
entries.caution: Not operating on Friday 9 October; check actual dates

entries.title: Nottingham International Market
entries.description: Old Market Square: five-day event 7–11 Oct 2026, Friday 9 Oct 10:00–19:00, free entry. Plenty of stalls and street food; interesting bus/tram-centred town visit with toddler, not a specialised children's activity.

entries.title: Twycross Zoo Room on the Broom Corn Maze
entries.description: 3 Oct–1 Nov 2026 daily, themed activity plus Gruffalo Discovery Land and animals. Additional £5 per child for special tote/maze entry on top of ordinary zoo admission.

entries.title: Bluebells Farm Park & Dairy
entries.description: Locko Rd, Spondon, Derby DE21 7AR: seasonal farm, indoor/outdoor play, animals, pumpkins. Operator calendar specifically lists Fri 9 October 2026 10:00–16:00 open. Ice cream parlour specifically CLOSED that Friday. Special Autumn Fun on the Farm event includes Pumpkin Village, pumpkins, animal areas and play, 3–5, 9–12 and 16–23 Oct 2026 (check admission ticket type). and
entries.caution: Ice cream parlour closed on Fri 9 Oct though farm park open

entries.title: Eden Softplay St Saviour's Church, Meadows
entries.description: former indoor play; multiple platforms now label PERMANENTLY CLOSED, despite outdated listings showing hours. Do not recommend without direct proof of reopening.
entries.caution: Permanently closed in more recent listings
